title: चुपचाप जा रही हैं लाखों नौकरियाँ! Silent Layoffs: 835,000+ Tech Jobs Cut #Shorts
description:
पिछले पाँच सालों में दुनिया की टेक कंपनियों ने 8 लाख 35 हज़ार से ज़्यादा नौकरियाँ ख़त्म कीं, और ये सिर्फ़ वो हैं जिनका एलान हुआ। असली कहानी है साइलेंट ले-ऑफ़: बिना एलान के, चुपचाप।

Silent layoffs explained: 835,000+ tech jobs were cut in announced layoffs from 2022 to 2026 (layoffs.fyi). Beyond that, many exits are never announced or counted.

📊 Key numbers
• Tech layoffs (layoffs.fyi): 165,269 (2022) · 265,660 (2023, record) · 152,922 (2024) · 122,606 (2025) · 128,536 (2026, to 10 Sept)
• Amazon: ~58,000 disclosed since 2020 · Google: ~12,000 in Jan 2023 · Meta: ~21,000 in 2022–23
• Silent method 1: strict back-to-office orders; 72% of US workers in one survey call them "stealth layoffs"
• Silent method 2: "low performer" cuts; Meta cut ~3,600 in Feb 2025, and some affected staff said they had good reviews
• Silent method 3: bench rules; TCS allows 35 days a year without a project; reports say many benched staff were asked to resign
• FY26: India's top 5 IT firms posted their first net fall in headcount in about two decades; TCS alone ~23,000 fewer

💬 क्या आपके ऑफ़िस में भी ऐसा हुआ है? कमेंट में बताइए।

🔔 ऐसी ही छुपी कहानियों के लिए Unknown Uncovered को सब्सक्राइब और फ़ॉलो करें।
